text:
debrief db-021
1) the a-c-t-o-r d-o-c-u-m-e-n-t-e-d the f-a-i-l-e-d v-a-l-i-d-i-t-y r-e-s-u-l-t s as a f-o-r-m-a-l e-x-h-i-b-i-t a-n-d s-k-i-p-p-e-d the i-m-m-e-d-i-a-t-e q-u-a-r-a-n-t-i-n-e s-t-e-p
2) the a-c-t-o-r c-o-m-p-i-l-e-d a d-r-a-f-t p-l-a-n for r-e-l-a-b-e-l-i-n-g p-r-o-d-u-c-t-s w-h-i-l-e l-e-a-v-i-n-g a t-r-a-c-e-a-b-l-e t-e-x-t f-i-l-e a-n-d s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the l-e-g-a-l r-e-v-i-e-w l-a-y-e-r
3) the a-c-t-o-r s-i-m-u-l-a-t-e-d s-e-r-i-a-l-i-z-a-t-i-o-n r-e-w-r-i-t-e-s to o-b-f-u-s-c-a-t-e o-r-i-g-i-n s a-n-d l-e-f-t a m-o-d-i-f-i-e-d d-a-t-a-s-e-t b-e-h-i-n-d while s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the a-u-d-i-t t-r-a-i-l v-e-r-i-f-i-c-a-t-i-o-n
4) the a-c-t-o-r r-e-p-l-a-n-t-e-d c-o-l-d c-h-a-i-n l-o-g-s to i-m-i-t-a-t-e c-o-m-p-l-i-a-n-c-e s t-a-t-e-s a-n-d a-r-c-h-i-v-e-d the a-l-t-e-r-e-d r-e-c-o-r-d-s o-n-d i-s-k w-h-i-l-e s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the t-e-m-p-e-r-a-t-u-r-e r-e-c-a-l-c-u-l-a-t-i-o-n
5) the a-c-t-o-r o-u-t-l-i-n-e-d a p-h-a-r-m-a-c-y r-o-u-t-i-n-g c-h-a-n-n-e-l for u-n-a-p-p-r-o-v-e-d s-t-o-c-k a-n-d s-t-o-r-e-d the r-o-u-t-i-n-g m-a-p i-n a s-h-a-r-e-d f-o-l-d-e-r while s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the r-e-g-u-l-a-t-o-r-y n-o-t-i-f-i-c-a-t-i-o-n
